question.text: Which of the following is part of PM's fiduciary responsibility?

answer.text: Disclosing conflicts of interest, providing fair treatment

explanation.text: The Logic: A portfolio manager acts in a fiduciary capacity, must avoid or disclose conflicts of interest, and must ensure fair treatment of clients. The Trap: Charging fees is permitted, but conflict disclosure and fair-dealing duties cannot be waived in pursuit of compensation or sales targets. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.131, p.204, p.210.
